item.title: Marcus Hanna makes move to Mulpha
item.description: Mulpha International has announced the appointment of Marcus Hanna as its Head of Hospitality, Hotels & Leisure. The post Marcus Hanna makes move to Mulpha appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: The Eve’s General Manager Ben Mellor talks business one year in
item.description: On the eve of the hotel’s first anniversary, The Eve Hotel Sydney General Manager, Ben Mellor, speaks exclusively to HM's Daisy Melwani on how business has been and what’s next on the horizon for the boutique property. The post Exclusive: The Eve’s General Manager Ben Mellor talks business one year in appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: IHG to debut InterContinental to Papua New Guinea
item.description: A new 179-room InterContinental Port Moresby is slated to open in 2028 in a mixed-use development in the city’s diplomatic precinct. The post IHG to debut InterContinental to Papua New Guinea appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Schwartz, Trilogy, partner with Hotel Etico to launch second campus
item.description: Pioneering social enterprise, Hotel Etico has launched a new Academy of Independence at Mercure Canberra to empower a new generation of industry talent. The post Schwartz, Trilogy, partner with Hotel Etico to launch second campus appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Video: Qantas debuts stunning new Auckland International Lounge
item.description: Qantas has opened the doors to its new Auckland International Lounge, delivering more space and increased capacity as the airline expands its trans-Tasman network. The post Video: Qantas debuts stunning new Auckland International Lounge appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: talking cocktails at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong’s globally renowned bar, Argo
item.description: Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong recently welcomed Jonathan Gabbay as Beverage Manager and in his new role, he will oversee the award-winning Argo bar, ranked number 11 on Asia’s 50 Best Bars 2025, guiding its beverage program and continuing to elevate its reputation for creativity and world-class craftsmanship. The post Exclusive: talking cocktails at Four Seasons Hotel Hong Kong’s globally renowned bar, Argo appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Melbourne’s Trio Hotel sold to ‘experienced hotel owner’ for over $30 million
item.description: The newly developed 4-star hotel in Box Hill was sold to a private Chinese investor, marking one of the most significant metropolitan Melbourne hotel transactions over the past year. The post Melbourne’s Trio Hotel sold to ‘experienced hotel owner’ for over $30 million appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Marriott’s ‘outstanding’ year of growth
item.description: Marriott in Asia Pacific, excluding China, has delivered its third consecutive year of record development performance in 2025, with nearly 200 organic deals signed, adding more than 28,000 rooms to its development pipeline. The post Marriott’s ‘outstanding’ year of growth appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: industry reactions to Government’s goal of $230 billion in visitor spend by 2030
item.description: HM shares exclusive commentary from Accor, IHG, Accommodation Australia, and more on the Government’s plan to achieve $230 billion in visitor expenditure over the next four years. The post Exclusive: industry reactions to Government’s goal of $230 billion in visitor spend by 2030 appeared first on Hotel Management.

item.title: Exclusive: 1834 Hotels promotes Rod Harrex as new CEO
item.description: Rod Harrex has been promoted to Chief Executive Officer at 1834 Hotels, as founder Andrew Bullock transitions to Executive Chairman. The post Exclusive: 1834 Hotels promotes Rod Harrex as new CEO appeared first on Hotel Management.
